question: What threefold reality is situated beginning from the brahma knot?
premises: The brahma knot is the point of reference
There are indeed three of these
inference: Three realities are situated beginning from the brahma knot, O beautiful-faced one.
uncertainties: syntactic relation of ā etāṃ trīṇi is compressed and somewhat unclear
plain_english: Situated from the brahma knot onward, these are indeed three, O beautiful-faced one.
